rationale: Layered design (api/service/domain/storage) with uniqueness enforced by the database, validation at creation time, and an asynchronous bounded click pipeline. The OpenAPI contract and V1 schema make the design reviewable before code exists.

risks.mitigation: literal-IP and local-name checks; DNS rebinding documented as out of scope
bounded queue with drop counter; accepted trade-off
per-client token bucket, hashed client key
